name: Vid
description: Find the moment, shape the sequence, and make the edit. Vid turns video work into a readable plan your agent can compose, inspect, and render in one pass.
alt: Vid motion illustration showing footage arranged into an opening, a moment, and a close.
caption: The original Vid motion preview, from this repository.
flow_intro: Bring a video file and the result you want. Compose the edit before touching a frame.
steps: Choose a local video, a timestamp, or a moment described by what was said or shown.
Chain trims, speed changes, zooms, transitions, captions, and audio into an inspectable edit plan.
Review the plan or print the FFmpeg command, then render the edit in one pass.
details: Index speech and visual events, then search for the passage or on-screen moment that matters.
Match color to a reference, mix a music bed, add captions, or fit narration to the video's timing.
Save, diff, and replay the JSON plan. Use the same capabilities from a shell pipeline or the Python library.
prompt: Use Vid to edit my local video. Read vid --help and the relevant command help. Help me select the moments to keep, compose the changes as one edit plan, and show me the plan before rendering.
prerequisites: Python 3.13+, uv, and FFmpeg. The setup guide covers speech transcription, narration voices, and caption support.
model_note: Model-backed capabilities use GitHub Copilot through your signed-in GitHub CLI account. Editing plans and rendering run locally.
title: Vid | Amplifier Smart Tools
